title: For all the people who paid more than 29.00 per unit of product id No.5. Gi
question:
For all the people who paid more than 29.00 per unit of product id No.5. Give their consumption status in the August of 2012.
Benchmark knowledge evidence: August of 2012 refers to the Date value = '201208' ; Price per unit of product = Price / Amount;

prediction.sql:
SELECT ym.XCL_021 AS consumption_status
FROM yearmonth ym
WHERE ym.XCL_020 = '201208'
  AND ym.XCL_019 IN (
    SELECT t.XCL_013
    FROM transactions_1k t
    WHERE t.XCL_016 = 5
      AND t.XCL_018 / t.XCL_017 > 29.00
  )
